# Pre-fix DUMP TABLE archive

Generated by real public SQL on main 12eeeb0205b5e87faef48660ddbcd8cb5e18baea
(Linux amd64, Go 1.27.1, clang 19.1.7, CPU native libraries).
The diagnostic compiled exact main production source through a Go overlay,
not the new hash compatibility implementation. It created:

    create table source(id int primary key,
      a varchar(10) default 'it''s',b varchar(10) default 'x`y',
      n int default 7,key ia(a));
    insert into source(id) values(1);

After synchronous flush of the main and hidden secondary-index relations,
it executed DUMP TABLE source TO '<directory>' (full archive, not metadata only).
The v1 manifest, READY and both native objects are unmodified producer output.
A metadata-only precursor reproduced the original PR LOAD rejection.

Companion frontend/testdata/default_quote_hashes_pre31067.json contains
definitions and literal physical/logical digests from main's production
tableSchemaHashWithOptions, including the old whitespace/expression rules and
both existing fallback branches. Neither fixture derives expected hashes from
candidate compatibility helpers. These fixtures certify this captured source,
platform and format, not every historical release or an old-server upgrade.
